summary: Nexera Technologies Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting the issuance of a $2,000,000 convertible promissory note (purchased for $1,800,000, 90% of principal) and a warrant to purchase up to 3,212,336 ordinary shares at $0.734 per share, under an existing $100,000,000 SPA. The note matures in 28 months, bears 4% interest (14% on default), and is convertible at the lower of a fixed price ($0.734) or 88% of VWAP (floor $0.14680), with a 4.99% beneficial ownership cap. Net proceeds will fund working capital. This is a routine financing, not a special situation.
